::: {#sol-max-min}

Let $x$ and $y$ be real numbers.
Either $x \le y$ or $y \le x$.
Both sides of the equation stay the same when $x$ and $y$ are swapped,
so without loss of generality, suppose $x \le y$.
Then $\max(x, y) = y$ and $\min(x, y) = x$, so
$$
\max(x, y) + \min(x, y) = y + x = x + y.
$$

:::
